description:
provider_playbook({"provider":"supabase","topic":"grants"})
Call for a Supabase RLS, policy or Data API grants question when you need the documented setup or role behavior. Use a short topic such as rls or grants. Returns versioned setup guidance, gotchas, dated changes, integration seams, existing repo checks and planned live checks with official sources. Available packs: supabase. Pass topic to return matching items; for a specific error use search_guides, for dated changes use recent_provider_changes.
Limits: guidance only; does not connect to providers, read your project, run checks or verify that a feature works. For RLS or grants, topic alone selects the Supabase pack.

provider.description: Provider id, for example supabase. Unsupported ids return the available packs.

topic.description: Optional words for the part you need, for example "grants" or "auth redirect". Only matching items are returned; with no match, the whole pack.

name: provider_playbook
title: Get a provider playbook
